In exercise of the power conferred by section 12 and 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Election Act, 2003 (West Ben. Act XXI of 2003), read with rules 22 and 23 of the West Bengal
Panchayat Election Rules, 2006, I, the District Panchayat Election Officer and District Magistrate of the District of Cooch Behar, as the prescribed authority appointed by the State Government
in the Department of Panchayats and Rural Development under notification No. ..............................., dated .............................................................................................................. for the purpose
of rules 22 and 23 of the said rules, hereby publish the draft of this order to determine for the Grams specified in column (1) of the schedule below, the total number of members, Schedule Caste
members, Schedule Tribes members, Backward Classes members and women members to be elected to such Gram Panchayats specified in the corresponding entries in columns (2a), (2b), (2c),
(2d) and (2e) respectively, to divide the area of the Grams into constituencies with serial number assigned to them specified in the corresponding entries in column no. (3), to allocate to each such
constituency seat or seats specified in the corresponding entries in column (4), seat or seats reserved for the Scheduled Castes or the Schedule Tribes or Backward Classes persons specified in the
corresponding entries in column (5), and seat or seats reserved for women specified in the corresponding entries in column (6) of the schedule, for information of persons likely to be affected
thereby.
